ns2:section.sectionText: The Discovery section of Psychology 100 takes advantage of the small class size by being more interactive and encouraging students' active participation. While covering the same content as other sections of Psychology 100, this section has four smaller exams and more opportunities for writing. In addition, students read some of the seminal works in psychology, and present information as a group to their classmates. Behavioral Sciences and Discovery course. First Year Discovery Program Course. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
